payme.title: Payme integration status
payme.ready: Payme integration is properly configured and ready
payme.testDescription: Create test orders to verify Payme integration. Choose between regular test order or Payme-specific test order.

steps.step2: 2. Fill in package ID and user ID
steps.step3: 3. The system will create an order and open the Payme payment URL
steps.step4: 4. Complete the payment in the Payme test environment
steps.step5: 5. Check the webhook logs to verify the payment flow
steps.step6: 6. Verify the order status changes to "{{status}}"

click.title: Click.uz integration status
click.ready: Click.uz integration is properly configured and ready
click.testDescription: Create test orders to verify Click.uz integration. This will create both Click Button and Click Pay by Card URLs.

steps.step2: 2. Fill in user ID and amount (in UZS)
steps.step3: 3. The system will create an order and show the payment URL options
steps.step4: 4. Choose between Click Button URL or Click Pay by Card URL
steps.step5: 5. Complete the payment in the Click.uz test environment
steps.step6: 6. Check the callback logs to verify the payment flow
steps.step7: 7. Verify the order status changes to "{{status}}"
